description: This file implements a server for an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) service using protobufs and a custom Rialto IPC framework. It defines a service class with methods for echoing text, handling file descriptors, and no-reply calls, along with client connection/disconnection handlers and a main loop to run the server.

classes.name: MyExampleServiceServer
classes.description: A server class implementing the example::ExampleService protobuf service with methods for echo, file descriptor handling, and no-reply.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: Converts the input text to uppercase and responds with it, logging the request and response.

methods.name: exampleWithFd
methods.description: Handles a request containing a file descriptor, writes a message to it, and responds with the server’s stdout file descriptor.

methods.name: exampleWithNoReply
methods.description: Logs a message indicating a no-reply request; does not send a response.
